sourceSentences: Aurora's damaging basic attacks and abilities apply a stack of Spirit Abjuration to enemies for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack against a target consumes them all to deal bonus magic damage.
Twofold Hex can be recast after 0.1 seconds while at least one target is marked, and does so automatically at the end of the mark's duration.

The marked targets do not need to be visible in order for Aurora to recast Twofold Hex. They do however need to be targetable; if all marked targets are untargetable, Twofold Hex's recast is disabled.
Scoring a takedown against an enemy champion within 3 seconds of damaging them will reset Across the Veil's cooldown.
Aurora is locked out of using all abilities, summoner spells, and item actives during the dash. She cannot buffer these spells to cast after the lockout.
Using a basic attack breaks the stealth at the end of the attack windup.
Aurora blasts energy in a line in the target direction and recoils 250 units in the opposite direction.
While grounded or rooted, The Weirding can be cast but Aurora will not dash.
If Aurora collides with the border, she dashes to the diametrically opposite side of the rift over 0.4 seconds, becoming untargetable and unable to act during the travel.
Collision with the border is essentially moving within range of it while being targetable, including via normal movement, dash, or displacement.

your e has a cast time and during that cast time you can Flash all you got to do for this is to press e and Flash immediately after with this you can increase the hit box of your e or simply reposition it during the cast time
start with an auto attack followed by your queue and recast your queue before the time is over
it is important that you go for Q into e into Q instead of e into Q into recur Q so you want to always start with your Q not with the E ability because your e will knock you back

press R and walk back after immediately it will teleport report you then on the opposite side once you got there you can press e and this will do damage to the enemy but knock you back at the same time to the edge
your bread andb butter trading and kill pattern is going to be Q EQ this procs your three hit passive and electrocute
you can input buffer Q before flash for a faster combo
you should 100% combine these combos together and do QE and then flash buffering both spells for a fast kill combo that's hard to react to
you can angle your ultimate to give yourself an instant wall to teleport to safely
while you're traveling by bouncing through your RS walls you aren't something the tower can aggro so in between shots you can send yourself back and forth through the wall

you can W towards him remember your hop gives you both stealth and movement speed this lets you reach your opponent and set up a QE trade that that they probably won't be able to dodge since you're casting your spells from stealth
Your "all-in" is an ultimate that you use to rush your opponent. Q and E, then attack, reactivate Q, and use W to catch up with the enemy.
So if you hit Q and add an auto attack, reactivating Q will activate both the passive and Electroshock, dealing significant damage.
